feature_description: Connects FamilyOS to your Home Assistant: shows what you choose, and switches only what you allow.
cap_view: See what the family chose to show from Home Assistant
subtitle: Connect FamilyOS to your Home Assistant. FamilyOS shows what you choose, and switches only what you allow, for the people allowed to.
none: FamilyOS is not connected to a Home Assistant yet.
none_hint: You need Home Assistant's address and a token. The form explains where to find them.
test_ok: Connected to {{name}}, version {{version}}. You can save now.
address_hint: Your Home Assistant's address, for example http://192.168.1.20:8123 or https://ha.example.net. Names ending in .local do not work from FamilyOS; use the IP address.
address_error: Enter an address that starts with http:// or https://, without a user name, a ? or a #.
token_hint: Create a separate user in Home Assistant for FamilyOS (not an administrator), sign in as it, and create a long-lived access token under Profile → Security. Home Assistant cannot limit what a token may do, so FamilyOS uses it only to read and to switch what you allow here.
token_change_hint: Enter the token again, even if it has not changed: FamilyOS keeps it out of sight and cannot show it.
token_error: Enter the token as Home Assistant shows it, without spaces.
advice_ok: FamilyOS reads from Home Assistant, and never switches anything you did not allow.
advice_checking: FamilyOS is asking Home Assistant. This takes a few seconds.
advice_token_refused: Home Assistant did not accept the token. Create a new long-lived access token in Home Assistant (Profile → Security) and choose Change.
advice_not_home_assistant: Something answers at this address, but it does not look like Home Assistant. Check the address and the port.
advice_blocked_address: FamilyOS does not connect to that address (for example a link-local or special address). Use Home Assistant's address on your home network.
advice_unreachable: FamilyOS could not reach Home Assistant. Is it running, and is the address right?
advice_unreachable_local: FamilyOS could not reach Home Assistant. Names ending in .local do not work from FamilyOS: use the IP address instead.
advice_timeout: Home Assistant did not answer in time. Is it running, and is the address right?
advice_failed: Something went wrong while checking. Choose Check again, or Change to enter the details again.
connect_started: Connecting. FamilyOS is checking Home Assistant.
disconnect_hint: FamilyOS forgets the address and the token. Nothing changes in Home Assistant.
error: That did not work. Please check the details and try again.
discard_hint: What you typed here has not been saved.
switch_hint: Only people allowed to switch devices can switch these.
today_block_hint: The things you chose to show from Home Assistant.
show_empty: Pick a few things to show on Today and on family displays, for example a temperature, a door or the washing machine.
show_limit: You can show up to {{count}} things. Remove one to add another.
show_search_hint: Search by name or by id, for example temperature or light.kitchen.
show_none_found: Nothing found. People, their phones and places are not shown from here.
show_too_many: Your home has too many entities to list. Type the id of the entity instead, for example sensor.kitchen_temperature.
show_unavailable: FamilyOS could not ask Home Assistant. Check the connection above.
show_id_error: Enter the id of an entity, like sensor.kitchen_temperature. People, phones and places cannot be shown.
show_label_hint: The short name people see, up to 40 characters.
show_label_error: Enter a name of up to 40 characters.
show_error: That did not work. Please try again.
presence_block_hint: Home, Away or the place beside each name, for those who chose to show it.
people_choice_line: Each person chooses this themselves under Settings → You → Where I am.
people_link_hint: Choose who this member is in Home Assistant. Nothing is shown until they choose what to share themselves.
people_none_found: Home Assistant has no people yet. Add them in Home Assistant under Settings → People.
people_taken: That person is linked to someone else.
people_error: That did not work. Please try again.
channel_hint: An admin can link you to your Home Assistant app
notify_test_body: This is a test text from FamilyOS.
notify_hint: Choose the phone in Home Assistant that texts for this member go to. The member turns them on themselves under Settings → Notifications.
notify_unavailable: FamilyOS could not ask Home Assistant for its phones. Check the connection above.
notify_no_targets: Home Assistant has no notification services yet. Set up the Home Assistant app on the phone first.
notify_privacy: Texts go to your Home Assistant, and from there through Home Assistant's push service to the phone.
notify_test_save_first: Save the phone first, then send a test.
notify_status_missing: This phone is no longer in Home Assistant
mine_not_linked: Not linked to anyone in Home Assistant yet. Ask whoever set up Home Assistant.
mine_home_hint: Only whether you are at home.
mine_place_hint: The name of the Home Assistant zone you are in, like School or Work; anywhere else is Away.
mine_displays_hint: Family displays that were given “{{capability}}” show it too.
mine_who: People with the permission “{{capability}}” see it on Today. The assistant does not see it. FamilyOS keeps no history and never stores where you are or were.
mine_error: That was not saved. Please try again.
control_hint: People with “{{capability}}” can switch it on Today and here. Admins have it at first; give it to others in Roles. Family displays and the assistant never switch anything.
confirm_hint: FamilyOS asks before it switches this, for example for a lock.
ask_hint: Home Assistant does it right away.
page_empty: Nothing from Home Assistant to show right now.
page_unavailable: Home Assistant cannot be reached right now.
history_item_empty: Nobody has switched this from FamilyOS yet.
